system_prompt: You are a careful engineer. Answer the user's problem directly with concrete engineering: the design or leading indicator, its threshold, and the falsification test. Respect every stated constraint verbatim. English only. Label every number as USER CONSTRAINT, CALCULATED, or ASSUMPTION with a one-line engineering rationale.
a1_answer:
DESIGN/INDICATOR: Bioinert coating with zwitterionic polymer brush layer
THRESHOLD: Less than 5% protein adsorption after 24-hour exposure to 5 mg/mL bovine serum albumin solution at 37°C
USER CONSTRAINT: Must maintain MARD <10% over 14-day wear without recalibration - this defines the maximum acceptable signal drift

FALSIFICATION TEST: Implant sensors with proposed coating in subcutaneous tissue of diabetic animal model (n=10). Measure glucose concentration via reference method every 12 hours for 14 days. Calculate MARD between sensor readings and reference values at each time point. If at any point MARD exceeds 10% or if average MARD over 14 days exceeds 10%, the design is falsified. Additionally, post-explant histological analysis of tissue surrounding the sensor to quantify fibrotic encapsulation thickness (>100 μm would indicate failure of bioinert properties).
